events.title: AI Study — Alpha-Beta Pruning: Full Tree Trace
events.description:
Block 2 (7:30-9:00): Chapter 5.pdf
- α = best MAX can guarantee (init -∞), β = best MIN can guarantee (init +∞)
- α-cutoff: at MIN node, value ≤ α → prune (MAX won't choose this path)
- β-cutoff: at MAX node, value ≥ β → prune (MIN won't choose this path)
- Prune when α ≥ β
- Complexity: O(b^(d/2)) vs Minimax O(b^d)
- Futility cutoff, quiescence search concepts

Break (9:00-9:10)

Block 3 (9:10-10:00):
Trace the 2022 or 2023 exam game tree completely — show α/β at every node, cross out pruned

events.title: AI Study — Hill Climbing + Simulated Annealing (Block 4)
events.description:
Block 4 (60 min): Chapter 4.pdf — Local Search section

Hill Climbing 3 problems (MEMORISE):
1. Local maxima — stuck at a non-global peak
2. Plateaux — flat region, no direction
3. Ridges — narrow peak hard to navigate

Simulated Annealing:
- P(accept worse move) = e^(ΔE/T)
- T = temperature: high T → explore widely, low T → greedy (like HC)
- SA solves ALL 3 HC limitations via probabilistic acceptance
- Application: drone route optimization (2024), robot navigation (2023)
